subject: Culture
title: Rivers as Deities
description: Learn Rivers as Deities in one minute.

hook.text: In 2017 New Zealand granted the Whanganui River legal personhood. The river now has its own lawyers.

buildup.text: Hindus worship the Ganges as goddess Ganga. Millions bathe in it believing it washes away sin.

discovery.text: Indigenous cultures worldwide treat rivers as ancestors. The Māori say 'I am the river and the river is me.'

twist.text: The Ganges is one of the most polluted rivers on earth. Sacred status did not protect it from industrial waste.

climax.text: Legal personhood for rivers is a modern solution: giving nature rights that faith alone couldn't enforce.

punchline.text: When worship couldn't save the river, law stepped in.

quiz.question: Which country granted a river legal personhood in 2017?
